title: McEwan Fraser Legal
description: mcewanfraserlegal.co.uk McEwan Fraser Legal is Scotland's largest property law firm and award-winning estate agency, founded in 2009 in Edinburgh by Ken McEwan and former footballer Scott Fraser, with 100 to 160 staff across 20 plus locations in Scotland. It was the first Scottish firm to win the Sunday Times Best Estate Agency in the UK award in 2013 and has since collected over 20 national awards including multiple Negotiator Awards and Scottish Legal Awards. Its unique model combines solicitors, estate agency and marketing under one roof with a proprietary Property Matching database and PRO tracking system. The firm operates 7 days a week until midnight, employs translators in 12 languages for overseas investors and runs 5,000 plus targeted landing pages. Revenue is estimated at 16 to 19 million dollars annually. CEO Ken McEwan has been nominated for Entrepreneur of the Year at the 2026 British Business Awards.
